visual_review.method: Twelve chronological frames extracted from the unchanged review video; full-frame views at reset, crossing, arch, feeding, withdrawal, recovery, staging, simultaneous pull, suspended span and final release.
visual_review.findings: Uncrossed start, robot contact manipulation, visible shrinking loop during simultaneous pull, compact final knot, open hands and cord resting freely on table. No identifying text in reviewed frames. Topology and continuous timing rely on independently replayed geometry.

grasp_retention_before_intentional_relea.scope: The existing measured pad/loaded-jaw witnesses pass at every recorded frame from 102.50 seconds until intentional opening. Open fingers after release are not labelled grasp failures; these are geometric checks, not force measurements.

measured_cord_geometry_audit.scope: Every recorded 20 Hz frame, actual capsule axes and joint endpoints. The minimum allowed axis separation remains 9.5 mm; there is no proof about geometry between frames.

full_score_evidence.interpretation: All required task windows finish before the 150-second limit. The environment ends at full score during the controller’s planned final settling wait; a later controller event is unnecessary for the completed five-second retention.

table-020.outcome: First complete current table-method demo: both hands retain the ends through gradual closure, simultaneous lifting and pulling; the measured span qualifies for one second, and the released overhand remains for five seconds. Recorded and frozen replay scores are 1.0 with valid recorded geometry, complete version-2 execution/physics audits, all-frame robot mesh checks and twelve-frame visual review. The matching Dream run is pending.
